name: Sleep
description:
Roll Persuade vs Riddle to set the Difficulty.

Choose any number of creatures within medium range with a combined Challenge equal to or less than the Difficulty. If a creature does not have a Challenge score, add together its BODY, HEART and WITS score and use the result as its Challenge score.

Each creature must roll Riddle against the Difficulty. On each failure, the creature falls into a magical slumber for 1 minute. On each pass, the creature's speed is halved for 1 round.
successes:
✨: Roll an additional d6 and add it to your roll result. If you get another ✨, you may repeat this effect.

🌞: The effect instead lasts for 10 minutes.
